0022600150.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-5, 15th in the West) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (4-0, 3rd in the West) for their sixth game of the season, with Sacramento on a five-game losing streak and Memphis on a four-game winning streak. Sacramento is also 0-3 on the road, and four of its players are unavailable: Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). Memphis won the teams' only 2026-27 meeting 123-112 in Sacramento on October 25, and it also beat the Kings 3-1 in the 2025-26 season series.
